verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs explicitly describe automatic schema handling, custom data type mapping, delete capture, and sync modes (soft delete/history) that produce structured, deduplicated destination tables rather than raw blobs, plus pre-built data models that turn synced data into analytics-ready tables (fivetran-docs-1, 18, 33, 35, 13, 51, 25). Community sentiment corroborates Fivetran's core reliability as an ELT tool feeding warehouses for analytics (fivetran-comm-1, fivetran-comm-2), though it focuses more on pricing/reliability complaints than schema typing specifics. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of exact typed-column mapping fidelity and deduplication correctness in destination tables (only vendor docs cited).
